journey.name: Hardware Wallet Transfer To Spending
journey.description: Drives the watch-only Transfer To Spending flow for a paired Trezor: Amount -> Sign With Your Device -> Transaction Signed -> Funds In Transfer, then verifies the new transfer is represented once in the hardware wallet's Core activity scope. The device pays the Spark deposit address. Requires Spark connected on a regtest build launched with SPARK_CHAIN_SERVICE_URL set to the regtest's Esplora URL (otherwise the Transfer Unavailable sheet opens), a paired Bridge emulator whose native-segwit account holds spendable regtest funds, and at least one older hardware receive row with a distinct amount.

actions.action: Launch the Bitkit app and go to the wallet home screen
Verify the recent activity list contains an older blue hardware received row with a distinct amount
Tap the hardware wallet tile (id "ActivityHardware") beneath the SAVINGS and SPENDING tiles, and verify the hardware wallet detail screen opens (id "HardwareWalletScreen")
If the first-run Transfer To Spending intro is shown, tap "Get Started"

Verify the transfer amount screen opens (id "HardwareTransferAmount"), titled "TRANSFER TO SPENDING", showing an AVAILABLE row (id "HardwareTransferAmountAvailable"), the 25% and MAX quick buttons, and a number pad
Tap the "25%" quick button (id "HardwareTransferAmountQuarter") to set a valid amount below the available limit
Tap "Continue" (id "HardwareTransferAmountContinue") and wait for the fee estimate

Verify the sign screen opens (id "HardwareTransferSign"), titled "SIGN WITH YOUR DEVICE", showing the NETWORK FEES, SPENDING FEE, TO SPENDING and TOTAL cells, the Instant and Later rows with Instant selected, the Learn More button, and the Trezor illustration

Tap "Open Trezor Connect" (id "HardwareTransferOpenTrezorConnect"). If fees rose since the screen priced them, verify a "Fees changed" toast and refreshed fee cells, and tap "Open Trezor Connect" again; otherwise signing starts immediately
Approve the Recipient, Amount, Locktime, and Summary prompts on the Bridge emulator in order
Verify the transaction signed screen appears (id "HardwareTransferSigned"), titled "TRANSACTION SIGNED", showing the same fee cells and the checkmark illustration
Wait for the screen to auto-forward and verify the Funds In Transfer screen appears (id "LightningSettingUp")
Tap "Continue Using Bitkit" (id "TransferSuccess-button") and verify the app returns to the wallet home screen
Verify the recent activity list contains exactly one new blue hardware Transfer row, above the older blue received row
Tap the new blue Transfer row and verify its detail screen shows "TO SPENDING"
